description: Deterministic Agent Workforce Early-Warning Report over YOUR OWN Claude Code transcript bundle, computed with the method of Anthropic's ‘How employment is changing at Anthropic’ (2026-10-16). Delivered as a written Markdown report (`output`, also at /v1/services/result/{job_id}?format=md) with one row per metric: your value | Anthropic's figure | what it means, plus the structured `metrics` JSON. Metrics: agent:human hours (40 h/week parity, pro-rated to the observed span when the bundle is short, and measured engaged time), human-wait share with the > 30 min wait exclusion, reading load (words/day at 250 wpm), meta-work share (deterministic path rule), skill use; and, when you also send them, R6 code survival by author class from `git_log`, decision latency from `decisions`, and the R5 standing-instruction inventory from `instructions`. Anything not supplied is listed with the export command. Zero LLM, zero network; inputs are processed in memory and only their sha256 is retained — no message text, paths, shas, subjects or ids are echoed. The full report carries a signed ProofOfAuditReport (kind 30105) binding the report hash and your bundle hash, and sha256(audit_hash|input_sha256|proof_id) is anchored in a 0-value Base transaction after the response (status at /v1/services/result/{job_id}/anchor, free). Pass `tier: diagnostic` for the R1+R2 subset, or buy the $0.25 ops.agent-workforce-diagnostic rung first. Bundle cap: 4 MB per request on this endpoint. Sending more than 4 MB of transcripts, or do not want to send them at all? Run the free local extractor https://craigmbrown.com/blindoracle/tools/workforce_extract.py (sha256 34f33389a564555e4d4476b86982feff10ca53eb6143bbc38139798d8dd09417) and send its `summary` instead of `records`: counts only, no message text, any number of days, identical numbers. The report then states that it was computed from a buyer-run extraction and whether your extractor matches the published hash; the attestation proves that input produced this output, not that the input is complete. (x402: $25.00 USDC per call)
name: ops.agent-workforce-report
